answer: By the pulse of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The willow holds work receipts rather than names, so the crystal of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit.
